6.3.2.2.2 Memory Abstraction Interface
Detection
Reported by the Eeprom Abstraction (see Eeprom Abstraction above),
only if the stack is configured in polling mode.
Reaction
N/A
Report
Depending on the configuration:
 [MemIf043] [MemIf053] The error shall be polled by the NVRAM
manager with the function MemIf_GetJobResult (job result set to
MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
Recovery
See NVRAM Manager.
